author: BITC0DE
quote: While Grand Theft Auto VI is an undeniable technical masterpiece with breathtaking visuals and a vibrant world, it ultimately feels like a "Cuck Simulator" that has traded its signature rebellious spirit for the relentless injection of woke culture. By prioritizing social consciousness and modern cultural messaging over the raw, unfiltered freedom of previous entries, Rockstar Games has transformed the series' iconic sandbox into a polished but often preachy reflection of contemporary sensibilities. It is staggering to see such a legendary franchise once the ultimate symbol of individualistic "cool" become so deeply curated by the very trends it used to define (and sometimes satirize).
